scripts.bench:apps:build:react: pnpm --dir apps/react install --ignore-workspace && pnpm --dir apps/react build
scripts.bench:apps:build:vue: pnpm --dir apps/vue install --ignore-workspace && pnpm --dir apps/vue build
scripts.bench:apps:build:svelte: pnpm --dir apps/svelte install --ignore-workspace && pnpm --dir apps/svelte build
scripts.bench:full: run-s bench:apps:build bench:core bench:correctness bench:browser bench:bundle-size bench:merge bench:generate
scripts.bench:update-baseline: node -e "if (!process.env.CI) { console.error('[bench] bench:update-baseline must run on CI only'); process.exit(1); }" && cp results/latest.json results/baseline.json
